jobDescription:
We are seeking a seasoned Programme Manager to lead a high-profile, complex Transition and Transformation (T&T) programme within the UK Public Sector. Operating within a leading global IT services and BPO prime-contractor environment, you will take end-to-end ownership of a large-scale multi-supplier delivery-integrating enterprise HR/Payroll technology (Oracle HCM / OIC) with a third-party Workforce Management / Rostering SaaS solution for a 24/7 operational end user.

This is a critical leadership role suited to a delivery heavyweight who thrives in complex commercial environments, can establish a single integrated master plan across competing vendors, and knows how to hold third-party suppliers to account under formal contract governance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Integrated Programme Delivery: Own and execute a baselined, resource-loaded, cross-phase master programme plan, aligning internal delivery teams, Oracle, third-party SaaS vendors, and change/training partners.

  • Multi-Supplier & Prime Vendor Governance: Act as the prime delivery lead managing third-party SaaS vendors into the end customer. Enforce strict commercial governance including milestone tracking, formal change control, subcontract flow-down obligations, and supplier rectification plans where required.

  • Transition & Transformation (T&T): Drive large-scale organizational and technical transformation alongside BPO service transition, ensuring operational readiness across a large, complex user base.

  • Agile & Release Alignment: Align programme delivery milestones with SAFe/Agile PI planning and third-party SaaS product release cycles.

  • Executive & Operational Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary point of escalation and alignment across senior stakeholders, operational frontline leads, software vendors, and internal leadership-providing clear, neutral, and commercially sound written reporting.

  • Risk, Budget & Team Leadership: Proactively manage programme-level risks, budgets, and resource allocation while coaching and supporting project managers across the delivery team.

Essential Experience & Skills

  • 8+ years of industry experience, including 3+ years operating as a Senior Programme Manager leading complex, multi-workstream transformations.

  • Proven track record in multi-supplier / multi-vendor delivery, specifically managing third-party SaaS vendors as a prime contractor or master vendor.

  • Significant UK Public Sector experience (ideally within secure, central government, or high-profile environments) alongside BPO Transition & Transformation delivery.

  • Hands-on experience delivering large-scale enterprise integrations involving Oracle (HCM / OIC) or equivalent tier-one ERP/HR platforms.

  • Deep expertise in formal contract governance: managing commercial milestones, change control, subcontract flow-downs, and vendor rectification plans.

  • Strong command of integrated planning (baselined, resource-loaded schedules) and clear, objective written communication suitable for commercial and executive audiences.

  • Must hold or be eligible to undergo UK security clearance (e.g., SC / NPPV3).

Desirable Experience & Qualifications

  • Experience delivering Workforce Management (WFM) or shift rostering solutions within policing, blue-light emergency services, or 24/7 operations.

  • Experience harmonising SAFe / Agile PI planning with fixed vendor product release cycles.

  • Relevant project/programme certifications (PgMP, PMP, MSP, or PRINCE2) and/or a degree in a relevant discipline.

Randstad Technologies is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.
